title: Best Policy Tracking in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34501v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning commonly exhibits non-monotonic performance dynamics in single-task settings. During learning, a sequence of policies is generated whose true performance is unknown and may oscillate significantly across iterations. Despite this well-known phenomenon, standard experimental practice typically reports either the final visited policy or the best among periodically evaluated ones, implicitly assuming that these selection criteria reliably approximate the best-performing policy visited throughout the entire sequence.   In this work, we present an empirical study on the implications of non-monotonicity for policy selection in single-task policy-based reinforcement learning. We introduce post-hoc diagnostic metrics to characterize performance degradation and assess the accuracy and efficiency of different selection criteria. translated_title: 强化学习中的最优策略追踪
translated_abstract: 强化学习在单任务设置中通常表现出非单调的性能动态。在学习过程中，会生成一系列策略，这些策略的真实性能是未知的，且可能在迭代之间显著波动。尽管这是一个众所周知的现象，标准的实验实践通常只报告最后访问的策略或周期性评估中的最佳策略，这隐含地假设了这些选择标准能够可靠地近似整个训练过程中表现最好的策略。在这项工作中，我们对单任务基于策略的强化学习中非单调性对策略选择的影响进行了实证研究。我们引入了事后诊断指标来刻画性能退化，并评估不同选择标准的准确性和效率。这些指标使我们能够在标准连续控制任务上评估常用的选择策略。
tldr: 该论文通过实证研究揭示了强化学习训练中性能非单调波动对策略选择的影响，并引入事后诊断指标来评估常用的策略选择标准能否可靠地追踪到训练过程中的最佳策略。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an empirical study on the impact of non-monotonic performance dynamics on policy selection in single-task policy-based reinforcement learning, introducing post-hoc diagnostic metrics to assess whether commonly used selection criteria can reliably track the best-performing policy encountered during training.
